definition.simple: Two roughly parallel sloping lines that a trend's swings have stayed between.
definition.balanced: In a rising channel, one line joins the higher lows and a parallel line runs over the highs. The lines depend on which swing points you choose, so write the rule down. A close beyond a line, by an amount you set in advance, says the old pattern stopped. It does not say what comes next.

example: Lows at 100.0 and 104.0, 20 candles apart, give a slope of 0.2 per candle.
